chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Chapter 196: Six Cultivators Ambush Ji Ning and Mu Northson
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning’s entry into the Yinglong Guard trials turns deadly as six Wanxiang Adepts set an ambush. With his Divine Sense, he sees through their trap and unleashes the Three-Foot Sword.
og_title: Six Cultivators. One Trap. Ji Ning Sees All.
og_description: Beihe Zhou’s friendly invitation hides a death sentence. Ji Ning, armed with his Divine Sense and the Three-Foot Sword, turns the tables on the Mount Yujue Wasteland.
twitter_description: Ji Ning detects a hidden assassin squad with his Divine Sense and decides to fight instead of flee. This chapter is pure Xianxia mayhem.
